layout_and_spacing.general: Use 'Technical Grid Borders' look. Expose the skeleton. Heavy use of 1px borders.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_mode: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-4) with tight gap-4 or gap-6.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_mode: Tetris Grid (grid-cols-12) with wide gap-8 or gap-12. Asymmetrical layout.
layout_and_spacing.padding: Containers with borders must use p-6 or p-8 internally.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or maximum rounded-sm (4px) for a structured, brutalist corporate feel.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.headers: Sticky headers use Solid Background with a hard bottom border (border-b border-zinc-200), not glassmorphism, for maximum legibility.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-zinc-200), NO shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-sm and -translate-y-[1px].

components_strategy.general: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for Landing Page. Use Heavily Customized Shadcn UI for Dashboard.
components_strategy.forms: Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. Square borders, high contrast focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:ring-offset-2).
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn Tables. High contrast headers. Zebra striping or subtle border-b on rows. Right-aligned numeric data.
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Use monochrome bars with one signal color (e.g., all zinc-300 bars, current month blue-600).

hero_image.description: Minimalist modern white architecture, perfect for a high-end SaaS corporate landing page hero or background.

testimonial_headshots.description: Professional male headshot for testimonial or dummy employee.
Professional confident business headshot for manager/admin dummy profile.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use APCA guidelines. Ensure active/focus states are highly visible.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include `data-testid` in kebab-case format based on role (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the landing page with absolute structural clarity using raw HTML+Tailwind. Focus on problem-solution narrative.
Use the Technical Grid Borders style for the HR Dashboard to convey 'authority and function'. Every widget should have a tight border and flat bg.
Do not use generic SaaS blues for everything. Use monochrome (Zinc/Black) for structure and Blue purely as a 'Signal' color (CTAs, Active Tabs).
Avoid heavily rounded corners. The max border-radius should be rounded-sm (4px) or rounded-none to maintain the Neo-Brutalist/Swiss edge.
Use the provided media URLs exclusively. DO NOT use placeholders.
The header must not be transparent. Use a solid background.
